rootCause.detail: Provider identity is not absent globally: the existing GitHub Actions secret-backed identity authenticated successfully for F5 provider mutations and remains referenced by the active F8 read-only predeploy workflow. The deadlock is that the only historical mutation transport was intentionally inertized after its one-shot, while the active workflow is read-only and the current session has no direct GCP connector/CLI. F8 therefore has valid single-use mutation authorization plus a prepared executor, but no currently permitted transport that can deliver the existing provider identity to that executor.
rootCause.whyPreviousStopsRepeated: The work repeatedly hardened the executor while leaving the authorization-to-provider transport boundary unresolved. Each later pre-execution defect was real, but none could remove the structural absence of a permitted authenticated invocation path.

minimalRootRepair.requiredChange: Bind the already-active predeploy workflow to the existing F8 single-use authorization and existing F8 CLI through a one-shot gated execution lane, using the already-existing repository provider identity, then permanently inert that F8 mutation lane after terminal PASS or bounded HOLD.
